notes.title: Navigation update
notes.notes: Added more arrows and "LEVEL 1" and "LEVEL 2" indicators to help players find the first levels in adventure mode.

notes.title: Visual update to improve shadows, lighting, and camera
notes.notes:
This minor update includes optimizations to make the visuals easier on the eyes:

- Made some light sources less bright and blinding

- Brightened lighting to remove super dark areas in shadows, so it's easier to see on every level

- Improved camera contrast and brightness settings, decreased light bloom, overall better look

- Optimized post-process settings for better performance

- Decreased default music volume

notes.title: Update v1.02 - New tutorial, better movement, better gamepad controls
notes.notes:
Today's update includes many useful improvements, especially for new players. The tutorial was rebuilt from scratch, gamepad controls improved, movement improved, objectives made more obvious, and a couple HUD improvements. Full list below:

- Training level redone to be faster and more gameplay-like

- Firinghouse now has virtual screen listing all challenges on current level

- Edited training messages and text at savegame doors to be more concise

- Changed default ball trail lifetime to 4 seconds to prevent viewport from having too many trails

- Changed default hand style to chrome, it's shiny!

- Added loading messages that say what is being loaded next for training and menu selection areas

- Removed "new record!" notification which was flooding the screen

- Added "New Trophy Point!" which shows on the HUD when a new trophy point has been earned

- Changed the collectable fox area light from blue to orange

- Added the training level to the arcade mode map rotation

- Training level trophy points now count toward the main game

- All tooltips automatically detect whether you're using gamepad or keyboard and display only relevant information

- Added "Door unlocked!" notification when an adventure mode door unlocks

- Changed around some door unlock values to make the level selection area easier to navigate

- Improved movement mechanics including slower speeds during surfing

- Running, flying, and surfing are all much more intuitive to do with the controller

- Activating sprinting by clicking L-stick on the gamepad now toggles so you don't have to hold it

- Improved controller stick sensitivity settings

- Fixed overhead satellite camera position on ForestPlinko 

- Made a caged-in walking path to the tutorial level, so you actually walk there instead of just warping around confusingly

- Added 2047 lore

notes.title: Minor lighting update
notes.notes: Improved lighting so it's less dark on CapybaraTemple and TrafficPlinko levels.

notes.title: Update Mar 8, making things more accessible for new players
notes.notes:
Today we're adding a small update, mostly based around making the game mechanics more clear to the player. 

We've added text inside the first 3 levels explaining more details about how to play as you learn. This should make the game mechanics much more clear to new players.

notes.title: Third and final pre-release update. DownhillMadness comes out Monday Feb 27th!
notes.notes:
DownhillMadness is ready for launch on Feb 27th! This 3rd update before launch includes a lot of polishing, bug fixes, and several new levels. Here is a full list of the changes in this sizable update:


Redid tutorial text to include controller buttons in explanations

Forcefield dropper can shoot even if you have zero money

Improved arcade tab information window to be smaller and located correctly

ZigZagMini doorway moved to not block name

Made mouse sensitivity 1/5th as powerful (the number listed exhibits 1/5th the sensitivity it previously did)

10x now says 10x+ in the tab scoresheet

Added "drop columns" and "plant tree" functionality to default controller bindings

Fixed so 'current' 10x+ counter also stops at 5 minutes as listed

Put in missing goal area in tubes catcher

Fixed the gateway for the wheatfield map so it warps correctly

Fixed lazyspiral map to disallow direct-shot to the 10x

Added double-click feature to lock on autofire, with notification, that appropriately disables when exiting firinghouse or switching to gun that can't shoot

Rockplinko level redone to be twice the size, new fox locations, also with larger boulders instead of small rocks, and a unique pond layout

Junkyard plinko level redone to add covers over 10x pools

Torchplinko level totally redone from scratch to be totally unique and much larger, now called ForestPlinko

Fixed bug where unlocking one door would unlock multiple doors, changed unlock values of some doors slightly

Fixed bug where some doors weren't remembered as being unlocked

Fixed bug where doors became glass material instead of being fully hidden when unlocked

Arcade mode time limit increased from 1 minute to 2 minutes for: TiltedDitch, ZigZag, OpenWorld, all 3 Mountain maps, Lazyvalley, and PipesMountain

Added explanations in the first menu lobby trophy room about how it works across all save files

Fixed broken trophy readout for fastest ball in menu area trophy room, and fixed readout for total number of trophies in first menu lobby area

Only foxes discovered in adventure mode count toward trophies, but in arcade mode they now each give a ₸500 bonus!

Fixed zigzag landscape shadows rendering incorrectly and resized level bounding box

Removed erroneous duplicate 6% round of interest calculation at the end of an arcade mode run

PipeCatcher level now has a wall to prevent direct shots in to the pipes to prevent cheating

Fixed a bug where if an arcade mode game was continued from a savefile, the shuffle list would be regenerated, causing repeats of levels  

Fixed a bug where it would say "new medal" at the beginning even if you already had platinum completed

Added a "credits" back wall in the main menu lobby, thanks for the beta test help Kirk!

Added new "warp to lobby" button in the UI menu, made it work with gamepad, and it warps to correct location regardless of gamemode

Fixed bug where if you played adventure, then played arcade, it would warp to the adventure exit you used last after arcade was over, which would trigger training because savegame number was not set properly due to not going through a savegame doorway because of the unexpected warping. Now the warp location is set properly after arcade ends

Moved the starting spawn location on each level closer to the guns and made it a standardized location in the firinghouse for every level

Each adventure mode savefile has its own independent list of foxes that have been discovered

Added foxes plinth to the level selection area, and another to the main menu lobby, and another in front of the training mode gate, to indicate how many foxes have been found on those maps

Added 'delete' button on the floor for arcade mode savefiles, and added a fancy UI popup in 3D space for it when you stand on the delete button, and refresh the displays for the savefiles when it's complete and shows popup confirming deletion

Added physics cubes in firinghouse area for fun

Added huge fractal underworld to wheatfieldmap and put 2 of the foxes on it, also increased the size of the scoring area and multiplier hoops

Fixed bug where 1x would sometimes count as a 10x

Created 3 new huge unique maps: FractalHills, FractalRivers, WorldMap. Placed foxes, added multiplier hoops, and added scoring areas to all of them. Added portals in the menu map, and added them to arcade rotation.

Gave 2 minutes on arcade for all the new maps, and added wheatfiled back to arcade rotation along with new maps for total of 32 levels. 

Mousewheel use caused blower gun to always fire, regardless of gun, Now works properly

Fixed some sounds not attached to menu volume knobs

Adjusted fox trophy area to have 105 total foxes due to new levels

notes.title: Another big pre-launch update completed
notes.notes:
This new update fixed many UI issues and includes gamepad support as well as many other quality of life improvements to DownhillMadness. Here is the full changelog:


Added gamepad default mappings and support for gamepad functionality

Fixed aiming coordinates to show only one decimal place always so they're less distracting

Got rid of training level in arcade mode since it's required in adventure mode

Fixed bug where occasionally arcade highscores would be ranked incorrectly

Changed firing rate adjustments to be more fine and have a lower maximum cap of 50/sec to match framerate limits

Added - and + keys ability to change firing rate without having to shoot gun, which displays on screen when adjusted, with new fadeout effect

Streetlamp plinko level lights decreased brightness

10x+ ball counter challenge stops at 5 minutes as listed

Capslock toggles the tab scoresheet, scoresheet left justified on screen to show maximum info and screen space

Fox discovery message only shows when it's discovered the very first time

6% bonus interest calculation at end of each round in arcade now applies to lowest amount of money held at any point during round (aka unspent money)

Trophy plinth has a handy display showing how many foxes have been found on that level!

Income explanations of last scored projectiles now stacks the text to show multiple entries as they occur (keeps a running tab)

Left side has a "new record!" text box that also stacks as it occurs

Also added "new medal" popup when a new medal is achieved

All levels now have scoring areas as they should

Added multiplier hoops to every level and improved existing ones, now it's possible to get 10x+ on every level

Added adjustable power to the wind blower gun and increased the overall power 10x

Added ability to turn left and right using arrow keys, doom style, and added this to binds and default settings

Added random physics cubes in menu and training levels for fun

Added gamepad control of the 2D user interface menu, so every option in the flat menu can be selected and changed using only the gamepad

Keybinds now save after quitting game as they should

Split the keybinds UI page in to 2 pages so it's not so cramped, added many new keys that weren't previously mappable
